form.notes: Form-associated (`ElementInternals`): submits `name=2026-01-05/2026-01-09` (an empty string when empty) whatever the language, calendar or time zone, resets to the `value` attribute, restores on navigation, and joins `<fieldset disabled>`. `required` (valueMissing), `min`/`max` (rangeUnderflow / rangeOverflow) and `dateConstraints` (a custom error) block the submit; the error shows after the user acted or a submit attempt.

differences.text: Uncontrolled (D-006): `value` is the ISO 8601 interval string (the FACE value, submitted as `name=start/end`) with the `value` attribute as its default; `range` is the `{start, end}` property upstream calls `value`. Native `input`/`change` replace `onChange`.

`hasClear` (default true) is the inverted `no-clear`; an `open` property and the cancelable `tct-open-change` / `tct-after-open-change` events expose the picker; `presentation` (`popover`, `bottom-sheet`, `adaptive-bottom-sheet`, default) is added because a range has no native control; `tct-clear` is cancelable.

`min`, `max` and `dateConstraints` are also constraints on the value (rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, a custom error); the span limits still only constrain the pick and never rewrite or invalidate a value that is already outside them.

The trigger is one button (upstream adds a second, tab-index -1 calendar button); the icon is decorative and a press on it is a press on the trigger. On a compact touch device the picker is a bottom sheet with one month and the presets as a wrapping row above it.

The trigger is named "{label}: {range or placeholder}" and stays focusable while busy or with a `disabled-message` (`aria-disabled`); the presets are a labelled group of buttons with `aria-current` on the applied one, never a listbox.

Outlined box with the trigger as its text; presets use the tertiary state roles for hover, focus and press, the applied preset the muted accent wash with the primary text and a heavier weight, and a disabled preset the disabled text role.

core.date-range-input.notes: Guides: [mwg:capture-location-agnostic-data] an ISO 8601 interval of calendar dates; [mwg:validate-input-after-interaction]; [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements]; [mwg:support-global-calendar-systems]. The picker surface and the presentation policy are shared with `tct-date-input` (`date-input/`).
